author: KEXP
description: Irish outfit Just Mustard fuse noise rock, post-punk, shoegaze, industrial, and trip-hop on their third studio album 'WE WERE JUST HERE.' Live on KEXP with host DJ Cheryl Waters, the band share a performance of "ENDLESS DEATH" and more from the record.
title: Just Mustard performs "ENDLESS DEAT" & more Live on KEXP
